Team —

Quick weekly checkpoint for the MAP and the current POC milestones. Summary below and a proposed revised close timeline given the dataset delivery slip. Attachment: aurelia_map_v2.xlsx (MAP with dates/owners).

Status summary (current):
- Ingest: pending (dataset delivery delayed by Aurelia)
- Model selection & baseline: completed (baseline eval run on internal sample)
- Integration demo: scheduled for 5/12 pending ingestion
- Acceptance gates: 3/4 passed in internal environment; gate #2 (end-to-end accuracy on live sample) blocked until data arrives

Acceptance criteria (short):
1) API latency < 200ms p50 on 512-token average payloads
2) End-to-end accuracy >= 88% on Aurelia gold labels (live dataset)
3) Stable inference at 250 rps for 1m sustained traffic burst

Blockers / risks:
- Data delivery: Aurelia indicated R&D will push the gold-labeled sample on Monday but we need format confirmation
- Ingest schema mismatch potential — Connor, can you confirm our parser tolerances?

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Sarah / Liam: confirm exact file format and S3 details (ETA: 5/2)
- Connor: validate ingest pipeline + provide schema contract (ETA: 5/3)
- Rishi: prepare pre-flight QA harness to run once data lands (ETA: 5/4)
- Marissa (me): coordinate demo scheduling, update MAP, escalate if data slips more than 48 hours

Proposed timeline (revised):
- 5/2: data delivery confirmation
- 5/4: data ingested into staging & baseline run
- 5/8: internal acceptance run complete
- 5/12: integration demo with Aurelia stakeholders

Please reply with any changes to owners or eta so I can lock the MAP and push the updated file.

Thanks,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — quick update from our side and two clarifications.

Update:
- We will deliver the gold-labeled sample to the S3 bucket on Monday 5/5 by EOD (had a last-minute IRB sign-off push).
- File will be compressed tar.gz; files inside are CSVs with columns: patient_id, note_text, label_code, timestamp.

Clarifications: 
- Acceptance criterion #2: when you say 88% on "Aurelia gold labels" — do you compute micro-averaged F1 over label_code or strict exact-match per note? We prefer micro-F1 but can accept either if defined in MAP.
- Can you confirm whether the ingestion pipeline will normalize timestamps to UTC? Our labeling uses local clinic timezone currently.

We'll upload the S3 path and credentials to the secure share once R&D hands off. If the format requires small tweaks we'll handle the re-export but want to understand the exact metric you will use.

Subject: Re: MAP: Weekly POC checkpoints — Aurelia Health trial (Week 2)

Marissa / Rishi —

Quick technical note after reviewing Sarah's sample spec: tar.gz of CSVs is fine; our parser will accept CSVs with standard headers. Two points:
1) Timestamp normalization: we will canonicalize to UTC on ingest but need to know the incoming timezone tag — if it's local clinic time without offset, we will assume the clinic timezone in the MAP unless you provide a mapping.
2) Label mapping: their label_code set seems to have fine-grained variants (A1, A2) — suggest we map to the 6 canonical labels used in the eval harness and include a mapping table in the MAP.

Blocker: our staging cluster currently has a maintenance window on Mon 5/5 02:00-04:00 UTC. If the data arrives in that window ingestion may be delayed ~3 hours. I can provision a short maintenance exemption but need greenlight from SRE and Marissa to escalate.

Planned owner tasks:
- Connor: ingest adapter + mapping table (ETA: 5/6 if no maintenance delay)
- Rishi: QA harness ready to run on 5/6 afternoon (ETA: 5/6)

I will add a small mapping example to the MAP and push an updated sheet if helpful.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

- Timestamp handling: Connor will assume clinic local time; Sarah / Liam please add clinic timezone in the S3 manifest when you upload.
- Maintenance window: Connor confirmed he can request an exemption; to avoid risk we'll target ingestion after 05:00 UTC on 5/5.

New action items (owners & deadlines):
- Liam: upload dataset + S3 manifest with clinic timezone & object path (ETA: 5/5 EOD) [attachment: aurelia_map_v3.xlsx contains field examples]
- Connor: ingest adapter + mapping table; request maintenance exemption if needed (ETA: 5/6 EOD)
- Rishi: run QA harness and post initial accuracy run results to MAP (ETA: 5/7)
